title: Resideo Introduces AI-Powered Water Intelligence with New First Alert® L7 Smart Water Flow Monitor & Shutoff Valve
summary: Resideo Introduces AI-Powered Water Intelligence with New First Alert® L7 Smart Water Flow Monitor & Shutoff Valve
body_markdown:
*New smart water solution monitors home water activity and uses AI to identify unusual patterns and micro-leaks, helping identify water issues earlier*


SCOTTSDALE, Ariz.


, Nov. 17, 2026


/PRNewswire/ --[Resideo Technologies](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4825116-1&h=1145318874&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.resideo.com%2Fus%2Fen%2Fresideo-home%2F%3Futm_source%3Dpr%26utm_medium%3Dorganic_social%26utm_campaign%3DL7_announcement&a=Resideo+Technologies) (NYSE: REZI), a leading global provider of solutions for home comfort, security and safety, today announced the[First Alert® L7 Smart Water Flow Monitor & Shutoff Valve](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4825116-1&h=2170324695&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.resideo.com%2Fus%2Fen%2Fpro%2Fproducts%2Fwater%2Fpotable-water-solutions%2Fleak-detection%2Fl7-smart-water-flow-monitor-shutoff-valve-3-4-in-npt-ball-valve-vws03y-3-4%2F%3Futm_source%3Dpr%26utm_medium%3Dorganic_social%26utm_campaign%3DL7_announcement&a=First+Alert%C2%AE%C2%A0L7+Smart+Water+Flow+Monitor+%26+Shutoff+Valve) . The new AI-powered solution applies nearly a decade of water-use analytics to detect unusual water-use patterns that may signal a water leak and can automatically shut off a home's water. The latest addition to Resideo's award-winning[First Alert L Series](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4825116-1&h=2844193377&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.resideo.com%2Fus%2Fen%2Fpro%2Flseries%2F%3Futm_source%3Dpr%26utm_medium%3Dorganic_social%26utm_campaign%3DL7_announcement&a=First+Alert+L+Series) expands the company's smart water portfolio with micro-leak detection, whole-home usage monitoring and intelligent insights designed to help homeowners, service professionals and insurers move from reacting to water damage to identifying potential problems before they become major losses.


"Water damage claims are among the most common and costly losses facing homeowners and insurers," said Paul Vacquier, Chief Executive Officer of Beagle Services, a leading national provider of smart water security and plumbing services who recently added the L7 to its product offering to homeowners and uses[Resideo Pro-IQTM Analyze](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4825116-1&h=2568617069&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.resideo.com%2Fus%2Fen%2Fpro%2Fproducts%2Fair%2Fservices%2Fpro-iqt-analyze-proiqal1%2F%3Futm_source%3Dpr%26utm_medium%3Dorganic_social%26utm_campaign%3DL7_announcement&a=Resideo+Pro-IQTM%C2%A0Analyze) for remote monitoring. "Resideo's First Alert water-loss mitigation solution helps shift the focus from responding to water damage after a loss occurs to identifying issues earlier and potentially reducing the impact. That intelligence offers a meaningful benefit for homeowners, insurance carriers and restoration professionals."


The L7 builds on Resideo's nearly decade-long investment in water intelligence, combining connected-home expertise, water-use analytics and relationships with insurance providers and professional installers to identify water risks earlier. Powered by[Resideo Pro-IQ services](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4825116-1&h=2505221304&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.resideo.com%2Fus%2Fen%2Fpro%2Fproiq%2F%3Futm_source%3Dpr%26utm_medium%3Dorganic_social%26utm_campaign%3DL7_announcement&a=Resideo+Pro-IQ+services) , which enables service professionals to provide ongoing monitoring and maintenance beyond the initial installation, the L7 also reflects Resideo's broader strategy to help shift home protection from reactive response toward proactive prevention.


**AI-Powered Insights for Proactive Home Protection** The First Alert L7 learns household water-use patterns and uses AI to help identify unusual activity, detect micro-leaks and filter out false-positive alerts while providing actionable notifications for events that require attention. When a water leak is detected, the L7 can automatically shut off the water to help limit damage.


"At Resideo, we are using our deep domain expertise, insights and technology to move the connected home from reacting to problems to anticipating them," said Pat Tessier, Vice President of Product Management at Resideo. "By identifying unusual patterns that may signal a developing issue, we're giving homeowners more time to act and helping prevent costly damage before it happens."


**Whole-Home Visibility** To help detect issues earlier and mitigate damage from water leaks, the L7 offers several layers of protection:


- **Dual-sensing micro-leak detection.** Combining turbine sensing to measure water-flow activity with pressure sensing, the L7 can detect leaks as small as four drops per hour, helping identify issues that might otherwise go unnoticed.
- **Automatic water shutoff.** When qualifying leak conditions are met, the L7 can automatically stop water flow to help limit damage.
- **Real-time alerts.** Homeowners are informed when leaks or unusual water activity are detected through audible and visual alerts on the device and in the[Resideo Connect app](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4825116-1&h=1856600753&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.resideo.com%2Fus%2Fen%2Fpro%2Fresideo-connect-app%2F%3Futm_source%3Dpr%26utm_medium%3Dorganic_social%26utm_campaign%3DL7_announcement&a=Resideo+Connect+app) . Through the[Resideo One portal](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4825116-1&h=3533990229&u=https%3A%2F%2Fpro.resideo.com%2F%3Futm_source%3Dpr%26utm_medium%3Dorganic_social%26utm_campaign%3DL7_announcement&a=Resideo+One+portal) , professional partners can receive micro-leak test results and alerts to proactively address a leak risk.
- **Manual valve control.** As an added safeguard, users have multiple ways to control the valve, including through the Resideo Connect app or directly on the device using the power button or actuator lever.
- **Backup power.** Common AA battery backup helps maintain core functionality during power outages for up to 24 hours.


**Availability** The L7 integrates with compatible


[First Alert L Series](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4825116-1&h=2844193377&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.resideo.com%2Fus%2Fen%2Fpro%2Flseries%2F%3Futm_source%3Dpr%26utm_medium%3Dorganic_social%26utm_campaign%3DL7_announcement&a=First+Alert+L+Series) solutions, providing comprehensive water-leak monitoring and optional automatic water shutoff capabilities to help protect the whole home. Thoughtfully designed for indoor or outdoor installation and in collaboration with insurance providers, the solution is well suited for insurance and water-risk mitigation programs, as well as property management, multifamily housing and new construction. Product owners also may be eligible for insurance discounts or rebates through participating carriers. For more information, visit


[Resideo.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4825116-1&h=138514295&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.resideo.com%2Fus%2Fen%2Fpro%2Fproducts%2Fwater%2Fpotable-water-solutions%2Fleak-detection%2Fl7-smart-water-flow-monitor-shutoff-valve-3-4-in-npt-ball-valve-vws03y-3-4%2F%3Futm_source%3Dpr%26utm_medium%3Dorganic_social%26utm_campaign%3DL7_announcement&a=Resideo.com) .


**About Resideo** Resideo is a global building technologies company that is a leading developer and manufacturer of critical control and sensing solutions for residential markets. The company serves professional installers and integrators across diverse product categories, such as heating, ventilation and air conditioning controls, combustion, life safety, security and water. Its comfort and protection solutions can be found in more than 150 million residential and commercial spaces globally, with tens of millions of new devices sold annually. More information about Resideo and its trusted brands, including BRK, First Alert and Honeywell Home, is available at[Resideo.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4825116-1&h=743755015&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.resideo.com%2Fus%2Fen%2Fresideo-home%2F%3Futm_source%3Dpr%26utm_medium%3Dorganic_social%26utm_campaign%3DL7_announcement&a=Resideo.com) .
